'''Hyphoria''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Trippet]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Ecstamira]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "The illusions woven by Hyphoria are neither dark nor frightening. On the contrary, they form a radiant world of happiness. If reality is too painful, why not drift into a beautiful dream for eternity?"

Hyphoria is a red rarity Tatari.

== Evolution Trial ==
Hyphoria's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Ecstamira]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Raise this Tatari to B quality.
* TBA

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Hyphoria's fan mail is always full of anonymous love letters. Being beautiful has its down side."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Hyphoria is covered in hallucinogenic fluorescent skin patterns, and can release spores that throw both Tatari and Zobos into frenzy. Kind of a loner."
